title: Talk Back to Anxiety: 7 Power Verses
hook: Anxiety talks loud; talk back with these 7 verses.
script: Anxiety talks loud; talk back with these 7 verses. When fear spikes, whisper Psalm 56:3, When I am afraid, I trust You. When your chest tightens, pray Philippians 4:6-7, I bring this to You; guard my heart with peace. Before decisions, claim Proverbs 3:5-6, I trust You to make my path straight. At 2 a.m., Psalm 4:8, In peace I lie down and sleep. When tomorrow spirals, Matthew 6:34, I won’t borrow worry. When shame aches, 1 Peter 5:7, I cast this on You; You care. When panic lies, Isaiah 41:10, Fear not, I am with you. Save this, breathe slow, repeat.

title: 7 Breaths, 7 Bible Verses for Instant Calm
hook: If you're feeling anxious, watch this
script: If you're feeling anxious, watch this. Take seven slow breaths, and on each breath speak a promise. Before the meeting, 2 Timothy 1:7: God gave me power, love, and a sound mind. When thoughts loop, Isaiah 26:3: You keep me in perfect peace as I trust You. When needs shout, Psalm 23:1: The Lord is my shepherd; I lack nothing. When you feel alone, Hebrews 13:5: You will never leave me. When plans collapse, Romans 8:28: You work this for good. When your heart races, John 14:27: Your peace steadies me. At bedtime, Psalm 4:8: I lie down and sleep in safety. Save and repeat.

title: 7-Day Scripture Plan to Beat Anxiety
hook: This truth can change how you see your struggle
script: This truth can change how you see your struggle. Here’s a 7‑day plan to talk back to anxiety. Day one, Isaiah 41:10 for fear: You are with me. Day two, Philippians 4:6‑7 for racing thoughts: I pray and Your peace guards me. Day three, Psalm 23:1 for needs: You provide. Day four, Matthew 6:34 for worry about tomorrow: I live today. Day five, 1 Peter 5:7 for burdens: I cast this on You. Day six, John 14:27 for panic: Your peace, not the world’s. Day seven, Isaiah 26:3 for focus: Keep my mind stayed on You. Prayer: I feel anxious; You are near. I release, You carry.
